rationale: The Phase 1 source registry already names the contribution-table URL as INSS_TABLE_2026.
The canonical table explicitly exposes the employee, domestic-employee and casual-worker progressive bands for competence January 2026.
The canonical table ties the 2026 values to Portaria Interministerial MPS/MF 13 of 2026 and states that 13th-salary contribution assessment is separate from monthly remuneration.
A yearly news article or search result is discovery/reference material, not a stable machine contract and must not silently replace the registered source.
If the registered canonical page is unavailable, the safe operational state is SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE rather than discovery of a different page.
